text: Skip to main content [图标] Welcome to the new home for Gemini API documentation in Google AI Studio. Dismiss [图标][图标] Get API key Audio understanding [图标] Copy page Interactions API Gemini can analyze audio input and generate text responses. [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go REST CLI from google import genai import base64 client = genai.Client() uploaded_file = client.files.upload(file="path/to/sample.mp3") interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input=[ {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this audio clip"}, { "type": "audio", "uri": uploaded_file.uri, "mime_type": uploaded_file.mime_type } ] ) print(interaction.output_text) Overview [图标] Gemini can analyze and understand audio input and generate text responses, enabling use cases like: Describe, summarize, or answer questions about audio content Transcription and translation (speech to text) Speaker diarization (identifying different speakers) Emotion detection in speech and music Analyzing specific segments with timestamps For real-time voice and video interactions, see the Live API. For dedicated speech to text models with support for real-time transcription, use the Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API. Transcribe speech to text [图标] This example shows how to transcribe, translate, and summarize speech with timestamps, speaker diarization, and emotion detection using structured outputs. [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go REST CLI from google import genai client = genai.Client() YOUTUBE_URL = "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ku-N-eS1lgM" prompt = """ Process the audio file and generate a detailed transcription. Requirements: 1. Identify distinct speakers (e.g., Speaker 1, Speaker 2). 2. Provide accurate timestamps for each segment (Format: MM:SS). 3. Detect the primary language of each segment. 4. If not English, provide the English translation. 5. Identify the primary emotion: Happy, Sad, Angry, or Neutral. 6. Provide a brief summary at the beginning. """ response_schema = { "type": "object", "properties": { "summary": {"type": "string"}, "segments": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "properties": { "speaker": {"type": "string"}, "timestamp": {"type": "string"}, "content": {"type": "string"}, "language": {"type": "string"}, "emotion": { "type": "string", "enum": ["happy", "sad", "angry", "neutral"] } }, "required": ["speaker", "timestamp", "content", "emotion"] } } }, "required": ["summary", "segments"] } interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input=[ {"type": "video", "uri": YOUTUBE_URL, "mime_type": "video/mp4"}, {"type": "text", "text": prompt} ], response_format={ "type": "text", "mime_type": "application/json", "schema": response_schema, }, ) print(interaction.output_text) [undefined] Input audio [图标] You can provide audio data in the following ways: Upload an audio file before making a request. Pass inline audio data with the request. Upload an audio file [图标] Use the Files API for files larger than 20 MB. [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go REST CLI from google import genai client = genai.Client() uploaded_file = client.files.upload(file="path/to/sample.mp3") interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input=[ {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this audio clip"}, { "type": "audio", "uri": uploaded_file.uri, "mime_type": uploaded_file.mime_type } ] ) print(interaction.output_text) Pass audio data inline [图标] For small audio files under 20MB total request size: [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go REST CLI from google import genai import base64 client = genai.Client() with open('path/to/small-sample.mp3', 'rb') as f: audio_bytes = f.read() interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input=[ {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this audio clip"}, { "type": "audio", "data": base64.b64encode(audio_bytes).decode('utf-8'), "mime_type": "audio/mp3" } ] ) print(interaction.output_text) Notes on inline audio data: Maximum request size is 20 MB total (including prompts and all files) For reuse, upload the file instead Get a transcript [图标] To get a transcript, ask for it in the prompt: [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go CLI interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input=[ {"type": "text", "text": "Generate a transcript of the speech."}, { "type": "audio", "uri": uploaded_file.uri, "mime_type": uploaded_file.mime_type } ] ) print(interaction.output_text) Refer to timestamps [图标] Use MM:SS format to reference specific sections: [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go CLI interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input=[ {"type": "text", "text": "Provide a transcript from 02:30 to 03:29."}, { "type": "audio", "uri": uploaded_file.uri, "mime_type": uploaded_file.mime_type } ] ) Clip audio intervals [图标] Pass processing ({"type": "static", "start_offset": "...", "end_offset": "..."}) on an audio block to inspect only a specific time range. Gemini bills tokens only for the clipped duration: start_offset (string, optional): Start timestamp in seconds (such as "30s" or "12.5s"). Defaults to "0s". Values past the audio length return 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT. end_offset (string, optional): End timestamp in seconds. Defaults to the end of the file and clamps to the audio length if it exceeds the audio duration. Must be greater than start_offset. [图标] Python JavaScript REST from google import genai client = genai.Client() uploaded_file = client.files.upload(file="interview.mp3") interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input=[ { "type": "audio", "uri": uploaded_file.uri, "mime_type": uploaded_file.mime_type, "processing": { "type": "static", "start_offset": "60s", "end_offset": "150s", }, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Summarize the speaker's main points in this segment."}, ], ) print(interaction.output_text) Count tokens [图标] Count tokens in an audio file: [图标] Python JavaScript Java Go response = client.models.count_tokens( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", contents=[uploaded_file] ) print(response) Supported audio formats [图标] Gemini supports the following audio format MIME types: WAV - audio/wav MP3 - audio/mp3 AIFF - audio/aiff AAC - audio/aac OGG - audio/ogg FLAC - audio/flac MPEG - audio/mpeg M4A - audio/m4a L16 - audio/l16 Opus - audio/opus ALAW - audio/alaw MULAW - audio/mulaw WebM - audio/webm For the complete list of supported MIME types and parameter schemas, see the Interactions API reference. Technical details about audio [图标] Tokens: 32 tokens per second of audio (1 minute = 1,920 tokens) Non-speech: Gemini understands non-speech sounds (birdsong, sirens, etc.) Max length: 9.5 hours of audio per prompt Resolution: Downsampled to 16 Kbps Channels: Multi-channel audio combined to single channel What's next [图标] Files API: Upload and manage audio files System instructions: Customize model behavior Structured output: Get transcription results in JSON format
